payload.name: Habit Loop
payload.fact: The habit loop is a behavioral model consisting of three components: a cue, a routine, and a reward.
payload.boundary: The model is applied to behavior change interventions, energy efficiency recommendation systems, and pedagogical methods for prayer standardization.

provenance.title: Artificial intelligence with IoT for energy efficiency in buildings

provenance.title: The Habituation Method of Dhuha Prayer in Standardizing Prayer Recitations at Khoiru Ummah Islamic Junior High School, Malang
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results show that the implementation of this method follows the habit loop flow (trigger, routine, reward) from a behavioristic perspective
